source_rows.role: December 2024 option identity and vintage score
source_rows.finding: The option assumes January 2026 implementation for site-neutral rates on imaging services at all off-campus HOPDs; it is not a statement of enacted law.
CMS finalized PFS-equivalent rates for drug-administration APCs at excepted off-campus PBDs, not the selected imaging option.
The January 2026 update operationalizes drug-administration APCs 5691 through 5694 for excepted off-campus PBDs and does not operationalize the selected imaging option.

CMS proposes, but has not finalized, PFS-equivalent rates for imaging-without-contrast APCs at excepted off-campus PBDs, with a rural Sole Community Hospital exemption and first-year Medicare and beneficiary estimates.

gate_rows.evidence: CBO 60908 fixes the selected policy perimeter and ten-year score vintage without establishing enactment.
The CY2026 final rule and claims update implement drug administration, while the CY2027 imaging-without-contrast change remains proposed.
CMS estimates lower premiums and cost sharing for the narrower CY2027 proposal, not observed or all-imaging candidate results.
No imaging-specific capacity, relocation, appointment, closure, or utilization outcome is published.
The proposed rural Sole Community Hospital exemption is a useful design control, not a finalized or observed access result.
Diagnostic timeliness, quality, coding, consolidation, and substitution require postimplementation candidate-coded evidence.
No current-baseline CBO rescore reconciles CBO 60908 with CY2026 policy or the narrower CY2027 proposal.

reopen_triggers: CMS publishes a final CY2027 imaging policy
CBO publishes a current-baseline score for the selected or finalized imaging scope
CMS publishes candidate-coded beneficiary, provider, rural, quality, or utilization results
current law changes the applicable off-campus imaging payment perimeter
